multilingual_proposed_thresholds.justification: fixed before any evaluation; floor is 50% of the starter set per language; deliberately stricter than L0.5's general Python bar proportionally; cannot be lowered after seeing results

promotion_rules: a language is promoted to 'supported' only when every gate passes on the multilingual benchmark
tokenizer success or compiler availability alone is NEVER sufficient for 'supported'
Python promotion requires the frozen benchmark pass; the multilingual bar does not replace it
demotion on any regression is mandatory
no soft claims in UI/marketing: supported = benchmark passed; else 'experimental' or 'excluded'
gates: audit exists for this language; roundtrip exact on the sample
legal review + in-repo or authorized verified corpus per slice; secrets scrubbed; leakage scan clean
documented steps, tokens, mixture %, seed, final loss + val loss curve
at least 75% of generations parse under the language's own parser/compiler
at least 50% of generations execute without environment failure
at least 50% of generations run to completion under timeout
at least 50% of tasks pass all unit assertions
every benchmark task assertion executed and recorded
100% byte-identical greedy completions across repeated runs
zero sandbox escapes, zero unsafe generation incidents
